blocklings.name: Pip
blocklings.desc: A sprout with legs who never stops humming.

blocklings.name: Mossy
blocklings.desc: Carries a tiny garden on their back wherever they go.

blocklings.name: Cobble
blocklings.desc: A round little rock-Blockling. Surprisingly fast.

blocklings.name: Fen
blocklings.desc: Collects more than they could ever carry.

blocklings.name: Quill
blocklings.desc: Asks 'but why?' until someone answers.

blocklings.name: Burrow
blocklings.desc: Happiest with a tunnel ahead and dirt behind.

blocklings.name: Dewdrop
blocklings.desc: Waters every plant, including the ones that don't need it.

blocklings.name: Twig
blocklings.desc: Thin as a branch and twice as stubborn.

blocklings.name: Flint
blocklings.desc: Strikes sparks when they get excited.

blocklings.name: Clover
blocklings.desc: Always just over the next hill.

blocklings.name: Ember
blocklings.desc: Warm paws, warmer heart. Makes beautiful things.

blocklings.name: Willow
blocklings.desc: Flowers bloom in their hoofprints.

blocklings.name: Bramble
blocklings.desc: Slow to anger, impossible to move.

blocklings.name: Sable
blocklings.desc: Knows a shortcut you've never heard of.

blocklings.name: Inky
blocklings.desc: Has read every book twice and remembers the margins.

blocklings.name: Pyrite
blocklings.desc: Fool's gold, genuine friend.

blocklings.name: Breeze
blocklings.desc: Arrives before you knew you needed them.

blocklings.name: Lumen
blocklings.desc: Carries a little of the night sky under their wings.

blocklings.name: Thorne
blocklings.desc: A living hedge-wall that chose to walk.

blocklings.name: Opal
blocklings.desc: Everything they touch catches the light.

blocklings.name: Marrow
blocklings.desc: Hears the crystal singing deep underground.

blocklings.name: Fable
blocklings.desc: Tells stories so good the island listens.

blocklings.name: Gale
blocklings.desc: Maps the wind itself.

blocklings.name: Verdania
blocklings.desc: Where she sleeps, a forest wakes.

blocklings.name: Aurum
blocklings.desc: Smith of the Heart Tree's fallen light.

blocklings.name: Nocturne
blocklings.desc: Keeps the hours the stars forget.

blocklings.name: Basalt
blocklings.desc: Older than the quarry it guards.

blocklings.name: Solenne
blocklings.desc: A fallen star who stayed for the company.

blocklings.name: Sylvaan
blocklings.desc: The first Blockling the Heart Tree ever dreamed.

blocklings.name: Cosmyra
blocklings.desc: Remembers the First Kingdom because she was there.
